EmailTemplate.name: LGBTQ+ Sponsor to Donor
EmailTemplate.subject: Join us for a Blood Drive
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear <Name>,
[Organization] is excited to announce that we are hosting a LGBTQ+ focused blood drive with the American Red Cross on <date/time> at <location> and we need your help to make it a lifesaving event!
Did you know that in May 2023, the FDA removed sexual orientation from the blood donor questionnaire, replacing it with the Individual Donor Assessment (IDA)? This change allows more people to donate while keeping the blood supply safe. On August 7, 2023, the American Red Cross was the first major blood bank to implement these changes, allowing more donors to participate in their lifesaving efforts!
If this is your first time donating blood, or if you have donated in the past, please check out the Red Cross LGBTQ+ Blood Donor Page at www.redcrossblood.org/lgbtq for more information. This page will guide you through some of the common questions the LGBTQ+ community has about blood donation and help you make an informed decision before you donate.
If blood donation isn't an option for you, whether by choice or eligibility, we still invite you to be part of the larger mission of the American Red Cross.
The rich diversity and intersectionality in the LGBTQ+ community also supports our sickle cell and Latino initiatives. For example, diverse populations are essential in addressing the ongoing demand for blood, particularly type O, which is frequently in short supply and urgently needed by hospitals. Notably, 51% of Black or African American individuals and 57% of Hispanic or Latino individuals have type O blood.
Each blood donation can help save more than one life. Our service is to patients in need and the people who love them, as we band together to show our community spirit and the power of the <organization> team when it works toward a goal.
Rest assured it’s never been easier to become a lifesaver.
Download the Red Cross Blood Donor App for helpful information on what to expect.
Complete your health questionnaire via RapidPass and save time on the day of the blood drive.
Enjoy post-donation refreshments as you reflect on the pride of service.
Sign up to donate blood at RedCrossBlood.org using sponsor code <code>, or via the Red Cross Blood Donor App, or by replying to me. Help ensure that patients battling their hardest days get another chance at better ones. Bring friends, family, and colleagues!
Sincerely,
<Name>
